New imports are only __ZN16IOPlatformDevice9metaClassE, __ZN9IOService13getPowerStateEv and __ZNK9IOService10isInactiveEv, all IOKit KPI symbols that the KC link resolved. The old import __ZN13IOFramebuffer5closeEv is gone. Strings: 'pdtextboot', 'serial_video_mirror', 'gopconsole', 'IOGOP: console-return skip=0x%02x', 'IOGOP: console-return acquire-request result=0x%08x'.
bundle_b4982465.super_dispatch: close() at 0x5f30 first records hadServer from fServerConnect (this+0x188). It then calls through GOT 0x8030, bound to __ZTV13IOFramebuffer, at slot +0x9c0. IOGOP's own vtable (__ZTV16IOGOPFramebuffer at 0x8078) holds 0x5f30, i.e. IOGOPFramebuffer::close, at the same +0x9c0. So super::close() is the apple-kext parent-vtable call to IOFramebuffer::close, as root reported. In the old binary that slot was 0, waiting for the KC linker to bind the inherited IOFramebuffer::close. Next: getProvider (vtable +0x6b0), OSDynamicCast via safeMetaCast against IOPlatformDevice::metaClass (GOT 0x8010), then gop_apple_soc_firmware_fb, matching the source order.
